method: Copied only checked-in scripts, evaluation package and reviewed figures/data into an isolated temporary paper tree with no sibling audit directory; executed the portable rebuild from /tmp.

event_inputs.MJD: 390000 saved original test-event predictions, recovered physical energy
event_inputs.SuperNEMO_illustration: Original saved 0nubb/Bi214 event predictions with score=energy_keV

outputs: Generated five tables and four figure exports in a temporary output directory; repository numerical data untouched.
pdf_note: NEXT PDF was byte-identical; SuperNEMO PNG was byte-identical. SuperNEMO PDF creation metadata may differ between renders.
